title: Grav engine and gravcore are distinct
summary: The grav engine is the ship foundation; gravcores are scarce upgrade resources.
body: Gravcores are resources used for gravtech buildings such as field extenders, signal jammers and power cells. The wiki lists quest-related acquisition and limited access after the main gravship quest concludes. A gravcore is not interchangeable with the engine that anchors a ship. Inspect the actual recipes and quest rewards before allocating one; do not assume a replacement engine or core can be crafted from ordinary resources.

sources.supports: Quest-related acquisition and gravtech crafting uses
sources.authority: Community wiki; check current game UI for consequential details
